title: PPC moves forward with plans for new 1.5Mt/yr integrated cement plant in Zimbabwe
summary: PPC moves forward with plans for new 1.5Mt/yr integrated cement plant in Zimbabwe
body_markdown:
**Zimbabwe:** South-Africa based PPC is advancing on plans to build a 1.5Mt/yr integrated cement plant in Zimbabwe. In its half-year earnings call, the company said that it is working with China-based Sinoma on the project. It is still considering where the unit and its quarry will be located. The proposed plant has an estimated EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) cost of US$130 – 140m. A final investment decision is yet to be made.


CFO Veliswa Rozani said, referring to the first-half of the company's financial year, “Zimbabwe contributed 37% of group revenue, up from 35%, but 53% of group EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortisation), up from 45% last year. The Zimbabwe business was the main driver of growth in H1, increasing its weight in the group.”
